name: app-management
title: Window Switcher & Badges
description: Switch to any window and see Dock badges for the apps you track, in one list.
author: bretbuilds

commands.name: manage-apps
commands.title: Manage Apps
commands.description: Open a list of running apps and their windows, with Dock badges for the apps you track. Rescans on every open, so give this command your hotkey.

commands.name: app-list
commands.title: App List
commands.description: The list Manage Apps opens. Run Manage Apps instead: it rescans windows and badges every time.

commands.name: configure-app-management
commands.title: Manage Pinned Apps
commands.description: Choose pinned apps, which apps show their Dock badge and in what order, and the Trash pin. Also opens from the list with ⌘⇧C.

commands.name: quit-selected-app
commands.title: Quit Selected App
commands.description: Quit the app selected in the list, or close the selected window when its app has others, and keep the list open. Meant for a hotkey.

commands.name: quit-other-apps
commands.title: Quit Other Apps
commands.description: Quit every running app in the list except the selected one, after a confirmation. Meant for a hotkey.

preferences.name: expandByDefault
preferences.title: Windows
preferences.label: Expand windows by default
preferences.description: On: every app with two or more windows lists them beneath its row. Off: the list starts compact and Expand Windows opens a group.

scripts.build:helper:window: mkdir -p assets && swiftc -O -swift-version 5 -target arm64-apple-macos14 helper/window/*.swift -o assets/window-helper && (cd helper/window && shasum -a 256 *.swift > SOURCES.sha256)
scripts.build:helper:badge: mkdir -p assets && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos14 helper/badge/dock-badges.swift -o assets/dock-badges && shasum -a 256 helper/badge/dock-badges.swift > helper/badge/dock-badges.swift.sha256
